headline: Bettervits advertises across most of its range, but its Marine Collagen (~£26k a month) has no ads at all, and spend is leaking onto searches like "c", "zinc supplements" and even a socket set.

points.title: Marine Collagen: start advertising it on the collagen searches
points.detail: Marine Collagen (~£26,000 a month) shows no sponsored rankings at all, while it sits at #32 for "collagen supplements for women" (53,000 searches a month), #31 for "collagen tablets" and #47 for "marine collagen". It was also out of stock 13% of the last 90 days, so stock and ads need lining up together.
evidence: collagen supplements for women: 53,196/mo, organic #32; collagen tablets: 25,740/mo, #31; marine collagen: 27,799/mo, #47; collagen: 161,213/mo, #60
Out of stock 13% of the last 90 days (Keepa)
Family revenue ~£25,683/mo, 734 units, 4.1★ from 655 reviews (Jungle Scout estimate)

points.title: Creatine, Magnesium, Glucosamine and Omega 3: cut ads on unrelated searches
points.detail: The best-sellers show sponsored on searches they don't rank for: Glucosamine on "c" (120,000 a month) and "turmeric", Magnesium on "zinc supplements" (28,000) and "mag", Creatine on "creatine tablets", "pre" and "fitness", and Omega 3 on "3/8 impact socket set". This looks like auto or broad campaigns drifting; negatives free budget for Marine Collagen.
evidence: Glucosamine B09W7VZJ9Z: c (120,184/mo, sponsored #9), turmeric (20,543), mens vitamins (5,279) (Jungle Scout)
Magnesium B09W7TBGPH: zinc supplements (27,782, sponsored #13), mag (16,983), magnesium tablets (15,192)
Creatine B0CJ9TZ4V8: creatine tablets (21,877, sponsored #9, organic #102), pre (17,428), fitness (12,138), creatine capsules (9,030)

points.title: Every best-seller: add a brand video, a 7th image and shorter bullets
points.detail: Creatine, Magnesium, Glucosamine, Turmeric, Vitamin D3 and Biotics each have only influencer or customer videos, 5–6 gallery images and bullets that collapse on a phone. Creatine scores 60/100 on our mobile checks, with the title cut off before the size.
evidence: No brand-made video: Creatine, Magnesium, Glucosamine, Turmeric, Vitamin D3 + K2, Biotics (Keepa)
Bullets over 250 characters: Creatine (4), Magnesium (5), Glucosamine (5), Turmeric (5), Marine Collagen (5), Omega 3 (5)
Creatine B0CJ9TZ4V8: mobile score 60, title cut off before the size

points.title: Metabolic+: build reviews behind a fast launch
points.detail: Metabolic+ is already selling an estimated ~£24,000 a month but has only 4 reviews. Enrolling it in Amazon Vine and review requests now protects conversion as ad spend scales.
evidence: Family revenue ~£24,213/mo, 692 units (Jungle Scout estimate); Keepa ~£17,495

points.title: Nutrition Geeks owns the shelf
points.detail: Nutrition Geeks takes 22% of the visibility on Bettervits' main searches against Bettervits' 3%. Their brand name (99,000 searches a month) already carries a Bettervits ad, so the comparison story (price per serving, strength) is worth putting in the images too.
evidence: Share of voice: Nutrition Geeks 21.9%, Solgar 6.1%, WeightWorld 5.6%, Bettervits 3.3% (Jungle Scout)

hero_actions.B0CJ9TZ4V8: Negate tablets, capsules, pre and fitness; fix the mobile title; add a brand video.
hero_actions.B09W7TBGPH: Negate zinc and mag searches; push magnesium malate (#57).
hero_actions.B09W82SY2B: Launch ads on collagen supplements for women, collagen tablets and marine collagen once stock is steady.
hero_actions.B0HJ2W239T: Enrol in Vine; negate patches, tea and berberine searches.
hero_actions.B09W86YYV3: Push turmeric capsules (#27); add a 6th and 7th image.
hero_actions.B09XJLZYDC: Negate spray and other-strength searches; push vitamin d k2.
hero_actions.B09W7K2Y6L: Push gut health (#39); negate prebiotic searches.
hero_actions.B0BJL68DMK: Negate the socket set and Seven Seas searches.

content_note: Content is the weak spot: every best-seller has 5–6 images, no brand-made video and long bullets. Mobile scores run 60–88.
ad_strategy_summary: Ads already show on 21 of the top 30 searches (70%), so the job is redirecting, not adding: cut the drift onto unrelated searches and move that money to Marine Collagen, which has no ads. Indicative ~£9,200/mo across the account.
amc_hypotheses: 55% of the live range offers Subscribe & Save in a consumable category, so repeat buyers are probably a large share of revenue on magnesium and creatine.
amc_questions: Which product do new customers buy first, and what do they add next?
How many creatine and magnesium buyers reorder, and when?
What share of ad-driven sales are new to Bettervits?
